hero.title: I align Product, Design, and Engineering to deliver the right outcomes under real constraints.
hero.subhead: UX & Product Design Manager focused on modernizing complex, secure, multi-product ecosystems with clear decision mechanisms and measurable results.

process.name: Discover
process.desc: Clarify goals, users, constraints, and operating realities. Install feedback loops that surface the right signals.

process.name: Design
process.desc: Architect flows and systems; make decisions visible with criteria, scorecards, and review gates.

process.name: Develop
process.desc: Partner with engineering; tighten UX→Dev handshakes, accessibility, and performance standards.

process.name: Deliver
process.desc: Measure outcomes; reduce rework; improve adoption and decision speed across products.

footerCta.title: Discuss outcomes, not just artifacts.
footerCta.sub: If you’re modernizing a complex platform, I can help you align teams and decisions around measurable results.
